snippet.title: HavenCraft Alpha 5 Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the free playtest! ► https://havencraft.dionicsoftware.com

Wishlist on Steam! ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481240/?utm_source=youtubedionic

About HavenCraft:
Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

About Dionic Software:
We already made Founders' Fortune and InfraSpace. HavenCraft is our third and biggest game!
